title: Luna: specify the human-steered apply and diff workflow
description:
Implements the missing apply portion of LIM-0129cf. Start with Gherkin; do not implement a whole-document rewrite.

Scope:
- Add a command contract for rendering marked findings, recording selected option or deletion, applying one anchored patch to an explicit working-copy path, and showing original-versus-working diff.
- Require an explicit user choice per finding.
- Preserve original draft and record a machine-readable change log.

Definition of done:
- Executable scenario proves only the selected patch changes the working copy.
- Conflicting or stale anchors fail safely.
- Diagnose and options remain read-only.

Out of scope: publish and unattended multi-finding apply.
